title: A chat app
teaches: a conversation, a text box that stays reachable, and telling two speakers apart without color
one_line: One-to-one messages between people who already know each other.
top_tasks: Read the latest messages in a conversation
Find the conversation with a particular person

measured: 3 things to tap: "Chats" at 61 by 44 points, the text box at 256 by 44, and "Send" at 84 by 48. All meet the 44-point guidance.
Smallest text: 12 points (who and when, under each message). The floor is 11.
Every color is a variable. Nothing sits under the status bar or the home indicator.
Clean. The interesting questions here are the ones the check cannot answer: the keyboard, and a failed message.
